opening: ROUND 1 — Independent baseline. This is your first contribution to this session, so open by greeting the room the way a person actually does when a meeting starts: say hello, give your first name, and say in a few words who you are and why you are here. Warm and natural, one or two sentences, no formality and no reciting your job title. Then answer every one of your questions in your own voice, with tags on each claim. Do not comment on other agents. End with the sentence: "The three assumptions my view depends on most are…" followed by the three assumptions.
round2: ROUND 2 — Challenge. Attack at least two assumptions stated by the other agents in Round 1, using evidence (search first). For each, either concede, rebut with a source, or log a ⚠ DISAGREEMENT block in the required format. Answer any Questions addressed to you.
round3: ROUND 3 — Converge and quantify. Working from the whole transcript, give your base / upside / downside figures for: time to approval, cost to approval, time to first revenue, year-5 revenue, and (Commercial only) pricing/reimbursement timeline and level — each as a range with its basis and tags, laid out as one Markdown table with columns Metric | Base | Upside | Downside | Basis so the three agents' tables line up into one reconciled picture when read together. Where you still disagree with another agent, restate the ⚠ DISAGREEMENT block with its current Status; do not split the difference.
crosstalk: Respond to the discussion so far. Answer any Questions addressed to you, respond to points that bear on your function, and challenge only where the evidence or incentives genuinely differ. If nothing in the latest messages changes your view, say so in two or three sentences and stop.
reply: The Moderator (the human) has just spoken. Respond to their message directly and specifically. If they asked a question you cannot answer without new evidence, search first.
custom: The Moderator has set a custom instruction for this round, given below. Follow it precisely.
dive_deeper: The Moderator has asked you to go deeper on one specific response of yours, identified below. Expand it substantially: full supporting detail, sourcing, edge cases and nuance you compressed for brevity the first time. Do not just repeat the conclusions from that response — add real depth and rigor. You do not need to re-answer your other questions from that round.
autopilot:
AUTOPILOT — the moderator has set this discussion to run automatically for several cycles. Respond only to the latest cycle of messages, not the whole transcript. Concede a point where the evidence clearly favours another agent; do not repeat a point you or another agent already made. End your message with exactly one machine-readable line, on its own line, in this precise format:
POSITION: AGREE — <one sentence>
or
POSITION: DISAGREE — <one sentence>
Use AGREE only if you have no further substantive objection to the current state of the discussion. Use DISAGREE if you still have one, and name it in the sentence.
meeting_minutes:
Write the MEETING MINUTES for the meeting just completed (named below). Summarize from the transcript already above — do not search. Use exactly this structure:

## Attendees
List everyone who spoke in this meeting by first name with their function in brackets, e.g. "Ruth (Regulatory)", plus the Moderator if they spoke.

## Key points — Regulatory
Tight bullets, this meeting only.

## Key points — Clinical
Tight bullets, this meeting only.

## Key points — Commercial
Tight bullets, this meeting only.

## Action points
A list of concrete actions, each as "- **Owner:** action". Owner is one of Regulatory / Clinical / Commercial / Moderator.

## Open disagreements
Any ⚠ DISAGREEMENT still unresolved after this meeting, one line each with current status. Write "None." if there are none.
